item.description: The AnycastIpList class expects Tags to be a dict but test expects it to be a list. Currently, the Tags property is defined as (dict, False) but tests require it to accept lists as well.
item.contract: Change the Tags property validation in AnycastIpList class to accept both dict and list types, similar to how other AWS objects handle tags. The validation should allow either a dictionary of tags or a list of Tag objects.

item.description: The RDS validation logic has two issues: 1) Error message doesn't match expected format in test_it_rds_instances_require_either_a_snapshot_or_credentials, 2) Validation logic incorrectly rejects valid configurations.
item.contract: Fix the validation error message in validate_dbinstance to match expected format and adjust validation logic to properly validate credentials requirements for DB instances.

item.description: The Parameter validator incorrectly rejects CommaDelimitedList type parameters when AllowedPattern is used. The validation logic should allow AllowedPattern for CommaDelimitedList type parameters.
item.contract: Modify Parameter.validate() method to allow AllowedPattern validation for CommaDelimitedList type parameters, matching the AWS CloudFormation behavior.

item.description: The AWSObject and Template classes lack proper __eq__ implementations for comparing with arbitrary objects. The comparison logic needs to be enhanced to handle equality checks properly.
item.contract: Enhance the __eq__ methods in AWSObject and Template classes to properly handle comparisons with various object types including TypeComparator objects used in tests.
